title: Sunflower Punk Girl Triptych
description: Three vertical panels show an anime-style girl with spiky black hair, sunflower accessories, and a yellow-black punk outfit. She strikes different dynamic poses against a solid bright green background, with a long braided tail ending in a sunflower.
prompt: Anime girl with spiky black hair adorned with yellow sunflowers, wearing a yellow and black punk outfit with corset belt, short pleated skirt, fingerless gloves, and tall yellow boots with black laces. She has a long black braid ending in a sunflower. Shown in three different dynamic action poses on a solid vivid green background, clean line art with bold colors and cel shading.
